newsitem.title: GERMANY: BHF ups '97 EPS forecast for Hoechst.
newsitem.headline: BHF ups '97 EPS forecast for Hoechst.

text.p: BHF Bank's chemical analyst Ronald Koehler said late on Wednesday that he had upgraded his earnings per share (EPS) forecast for the German chemical group Hoechst AG to 3.70 marks from a previous 3.40 marks.

The upgrade came in the wake of first-half 1997 figures from Hoechst which saw an 18-percent drop in operating profit to 2.27 billion marks from 2.775 billion in the year-ago period when the group reaped the benefits of extraordinary income from disposals.
"Ultimately these figures are above my expectations. I expect a move higher in the second half, especially given the favourable foreign exchange situation," Koehler said.
Koehler left his EPS outlook for 1998 unchanged at 4.50 marks. The recommendation on the share remains "buy".
